boot_fight.gml: run_new(); var c = global.run.car; var sp = car_find_space(c, fac("rep_1").cells); if (is_array(sp)) car_place(c, "rep_1", sp[0], sp[1], 0); global.run.sector = 2; combat_begin("bandits", false, false); return true;

stress.gml: var cb = global.cb; var c = cb.player; c.harpoon = 8; for (var e = 0; e < array_length(cb.enemies); e++) cb.enemies[e].harpoon = 5; for (var i = 0; i < array_length(c.facs); i++) { var k = i mod 4; if (k == 0) c.facs[i].st.fire = 9; if (k == 1) c.facs[i].st.elec = 9; if (k == 2) c.facs[i].st.acid = 9; if (k == 3) { c.facs[i].st.oil = 9; c.facs[i].hp = 0; } } for (var d = 0; d < array_length(cb.drones); d++) cb.drones[d].fac = d; combat_pop(cb.layout_p.px + 40, cb.layout_p.py - 20, "-7", global.PAL.danger); return true;

wreck_one.gml: var cb = global.cb; if (array_length(cb.enemies) == 0) return -1; cb.enemies[0].hull = 0; return 1;

boss_fight.gml: run_new(); global.run.sector = 3; combat_begin("corps", false, true); return true;

sensors_on.gml: var c = global.run.car; var sp = car_find_space(c, fac("sen_1").cells); if (is_array(sp)) car_place(c, "sen_1", sp[0], sp[1], 0); return car_has_sensors(c);

and with a wreck on the road
